name: EQB Inc.
summary: EQB Inc., through its subsidiary, Equitable Bank, provides personal and commercial banking services to retail and commercial customers in Canada. It accepts term deposits, guaranteed investment certificates, high-interest savings accounts, institutional deposit notes, and covered bonds, as well as specialized financing solutions. The company also offers single-family residential mortgages, reverse mortgages, and home equity lines of credit, as well as insurance loans.
